__comment: The drone-dropped bomblet as a bakeable model, so a loaded drone can draw the weapon it is actually carrying as part of its own flywheel instance. Centred on the origin (unlike a block model) because the drone positions it by its payload mount, and 4.8 pixels a side to match BombletRenderer's own 0.15 half-extent: what hangs under the drone is the size of what falls off it.
